name: Fear of Boof Prepackaged Flower Smalls | Hardcore OG
description: This legendary cultivar has roots stretching back more than 15 years. Highly respected for its rarity and elusiveness. There is a lot of history behind this classic strain. We have successfully unlocked expressions of the cured flower that are very reminiscent of the famous award winning extract that had consumers falling in love since it came on the scene. The flavor profile is rich and indulgent, featuring heavy coffee and earthy notes accented by chocolate and caramel undertones. Hardcore OG is the most potent offering in the FOB collection, delivering an exceptionally powerful and sedative high.
